claim: Patchline ships a public office-hours and triage rotation with published response-time SLAs met for a year. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the response-time SLA claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make office-hours-triage-sla-gate`.
